details: Bitcoin experienced a significant rally, pushing its price above $81,000, driven by cooling expectations for aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded their largest single-day inflow since January, totaling $731 million. This inflow indicates robust institutional demand and a clear rebound in risk appetite across the broader crypto market.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $81,000 on Strong ETF Inflows

details: Privacy-focused altcoin Zcash (ZEC) surged by approximately 18%, breaking above the $1,000 mark. This strong performance is part of a broader altcoin rally, with some tokens posting over 10% daily gains, indicating renewed investor interest in risk assets. The surge is also linked to increased ETF inflows and growing activity among miners.
title: Zcash Rallies Over 18% as Privacy Coins Gain Traction

details: Crypto exchange Coinbase has filed registration documents with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to offer "equity perpetuals." These are derivative contracts that track underlying assets without an expiration date. The product would also require approval from the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) and aims to provide a regulated pathway for U.S. investors to access such offerings, which have seen demand internationally.
title: Coinbase Seeks SEC Approval for Equity Perpetuals

details: The Robinhood Chain experienced a network outage, causing it to stop producing new blocks for at least 14 minutes and stalling transactions. The cause of the disruption remains undisclosed. This incident highlights potential vulnerabilities and centralization concerns, as the chain's design relies on a single sequencer for ordering all transactions.
title: Robinhood Chain Suffers 14-Minute Outage, Halting Block Production

details: Hardware wallet provider Trezor announced that a security breach at its third-party logistics partner, ShipMonk, has impacted an additional 67,000 customers. This latest disclosure follows previous reports of customer data exposure through the same vendor, raising ongoing concerns about supply chain security for crypto hardware.
title: Trezor Reports Additional 67,000 Customers Affected by Third-Party Breach
